subject: Request: key telemetry sampleset + HSM attestation for SIG review
messages:
From: Asha Rao <security@fintegrity.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: telemetry exports + HSM attestation for SIG review

Hi Irene,

We are starting a SIG/SOC2 deep dive for Fintegrity and need several items from Redwood to complete the crypto evidence pack. Can you please provide the following (redacted/anonymized where appropriate):

1) A 30-day sample of KMS/HSM telemetry that shows key usage events (create, rotate, wrap/unwrap, destroy) for all tenant-facing keys. CSV preferred.
2) Key rotation proofs for the last 24 months (rotation timestamps, key IDs, and operator ids).
3) The HSM attestation chain (vendor-signed attestation, firmware version, and tamper seal statement).
4) A key access matrix that maps roles to key operations (who can wrap/unlock, who can request rotation).
5) Any PKCS#11 / PKCS#8 signed artifacts you can provide; if you have PKCS#11 signed attestation blobs we can ingest as part of the SIG.
6) A secure transfer mechanism (SFTP/dropbox link) and a contact for technical handoff.

Target deadline: 2027-06-17 EOW if possible. If you need to stagger deliverables we can accept the telemetry + index first and the attestation chain shortly after.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Security Manager, Fintegrity
security@fintegrity.com

--
Fintegrity compliance team
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <security@fintegrity.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: telemetry exports + HSM attestation for SIG review

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items requested. Proposed plan and scope below; please let me know if you need more detail on any item.

Deliverables (proposed):
- redwood_rotation_telemetry_sample_v1.csv (30-day sample; tenant identifiers hashed with sha256; columns: timestamp,event_type,key_id,wrapped_key_id,actor_id,region)
- rotation_index_mapping.jsonl (newline-delimited mapping of key_id -> wrapped_blob_id -> rotation_epoch)
- hsm_attestation_chain_20270601.pdf (vendor-signed chain + firmware manifest; PDF with vendor metadata)
- rotation audit SQL snippets and hashes (for auditor reproducibility)
- sftp_instructions.txt (one-time creds flow + host + checksum)

We will redact tenant PII and present stable hashes for tenant id so the SIG team can correlate events without seeing raw tenant identifiers. If you need raw identifiers we will need an approved NDA addendum.

PKCS#11: We have PKCS#11-based signing in our HSMs; if you require the PKCS#11-signed blobs, please confirm the exact profile you need (mechanism e.g. CKM_SHA256_RSA_PKCS) and whether you require a timestamp authority (TSA) signature on the attestation. If you confirm, we will include pkcs11-sig-request.txt describing the exact signing chain.

Proposed timeline:
- 2027-06-13 03:00 UTC: telemetry CSV + rotation_index_mapping + sftp instructions (deliver via SFTP).
- 2027-06-14 15:00 UTC: HSM attestation PDF (vendor-signed).

Internal owners: Jonas for telemetry export & anonymization; Markus for HSM attestation packaging; Laura for compliance review.

If that schedule works, I will have Jonas open the SFTP drop and share one-time credentials.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security (Compliance Projects)
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: telemetry exports + proposed artifacts (internal)

Irene / team —

Prepared the sample set and SFTP drop. Notes below and attachments in this thread.

Artifacts attached to the outbound package (stubs):
- redwood_rotation_telemetry_sample_v1.csv (sample, 30 days, tenant_id hashed with sha256) — sha256: 3b2f9d8a9a47c1d2f5c8a9b7d6e2c4f3a1e5d6c7b8a9f1e2d3c4b5a6f7e8d9c0
- rotation_index_mapping.jsonl — maps redwood_key_id -> wrapped_blob_id -> rotation_epoch (newline-delimited JSON)
- hsm_attestation_chain_20270601.pdf (vendor chain; includes firmware manifest and attestation statements)
- sftp_instructions.txt — SFTP host: sftp.redwood-secure.com, path: /incoming/fintegrity/FIN-2345, token: ONE-TIME-TOKEN-REDACTED (will rotate after transfer).
- pkcs11-sig-request.txt — describes requested signature profile and chain (CKM_SHA256_RSA_PKCS, timestamp via RFC3161).

SFTP details:
- Host: sftp.redwood-secure.com
- Port: 22
- Path: /incoming/fintegrity/FIN-2345
- Username: fintegrity_drop
- Auth: one-time token (we will send token over separate channel)
- Checksum: we will provide a SHA256 manifest file in the drop so you can verify integrity.

Redaction / privacy: tenant ids are hashed (sha256) and we have removed any request-level payloads. We retained operator_id values as internal usernames; if you prefer operator ids be redacted to role identifiers we can replace them with role:rotation_engine_operator_1 etc.

Planned delivery window: 2027-06-13 03:00 UTC. I will upload the package then and email the token over an encrypted channel (Signal/1Password send).

If Fintegrity requires the PKCS#11-signed blob with TSA timestamping, Markus will coordinate with the HSM vendor (we expect vendor to provide signed attestation by 2027-06-14).

Jonas
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Asha Rao <security@fintegrity.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: telemetry exports + HSM attestation for SIG review

Irene / Jonas —

Thanks, we received the SFTP instructions and will pull the package once you post. A few follow-ups:

- Please include a PKCS#11-signed attestation chain if possible; we specifically need an RFC3161 TSA timestamped signature on the top-level attestation blob. Can you confirm whether the vendor can provide TSA-signed chain or if Redwood will timestamp it?
- Please package the artifacts in a ZIP with a top-level manifest.txt that lists filenames and SHA256 checksums (we will verify integrity).
- For the key access matrix, we prefer role-mapped names rather than individual operator usernames for the public evidence set (so the auditor sees 'rotation_engine' and 'secrets_admin' roles). Can you provide both the role-mapped and the raw mapping under an NDA?

If helpful, we can set up a 30-minute technical call Thursday 2027-06-17 to walk the auditor through the artifacts.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Security Manager, Fintegrity
security@fintegrity.com
